name: lethal-company-udp
description: Lethal Company direct/LAN UDP profile for localhost:7777 experiments
author: plugin-studio

launch_args: Point the game/mod direct or LAN target at 127.0.0.1:7777.
notes: Official Steam lobby/relay traffic is outside ROAD.
Object/physics desync can happen on direct LAN without ROAD; compare against direct LAN before blaming the proxy.
ROAD only carries direct/LAN/local IP:port traffic; official Steam lobby/relay traffic is outside this port proxy.
Use this profile when the game or mod talks to localhost:7777.
Keep udp_peer_broadcast disabled unless packet captures prove clients must receive each other's client-origin packets directly.
